invariants: Synchronous Host-exit finalization contains each target failure and retains current live/terminal registries until normal owned disposal finishes.
A pending ordinary wait remains owned after synchronous finalization and is retired only after its admitted wait completes.
Normal disposal admits terminal termination before a resolved ordinary outcome's wait continuation; failure fallback invokes both target-owned Host-exit interfaces in the source order.
A single failure is rethrown by exact identity; multiple failures retain original ordered member instances in AggregateError with unchanged message.
Actual extracted embedded Python 3.8.10 service observations preserve all four controlled handle scenarios and declared module/root provenance.
identity: Exact owned handle entries, original single-error object and ordered aggregate member identities at declared observation barriers.
ownership: Authoritative live/terminal registries persist through pending cleanup and final fallback; only the completed normal disposal clears them. Handles own their shutdown interfaces.
ordering: Ordinary terminate and terminal termination admission precede ordinary wait continuation; all normal outcomes settle before fallback and registry retirement.
errors: Per-target finalization failures are contained; normal single failure retains identity, and multiple failures use the shared AggregateError with original members/message/order.
cancellation: This contract covers awaited normal disposal and invoked finalizer at explicit handle barriers; actual operating-system Host termination, process trees and caller cancellation beyond the existing owner are separate.
adaptation: Python 3.8 terminal Task admission mirrors the source synchronous async-function prefix versus resolved Promise continuation. Controlled handles are declared observer seams, with no invented pid or OS outcome.
open_questions: Current bounded qualification is recorded in rc1_review. Original five-file subprocess baseline has two Windows fixture translation failures retained separately. Real root/descendant trees, Host crash/exit, terminal/WinPTY, background Jobs and deferred Win7 remain unaccepted.

rc1_review.scope: Current finite executable provider/consumer corpora, original-browser and extracted observations in the single full receipt. Historical alpha evidence remains historical; no inventory-wide parity, arbitrary ABI/history, paid-provider or Win7 certification.
